title: Minimize String Length
summary: Given a string, you can delete the nearest occurrence of any character to the left or right of the chosen index.
statement: Given a string, you can delete the nearest occurrence of any character to the left or right of the chosen index. Perform these operations to minimize the string's length, and return the minimized length as an integer.
constraints: Choose a character occurrence; if the same character occurs on its left, delete the closest such occurrence, and likewise on its right.
Repeat the operation any number of times.
Return the minimum achievable string length.
hints: At least one occurrence of every distinct character must remain.
Repeatedly center operations within occurrences of the same character to remove extras.
Count the number of distinct characters in s.
Operations never remove the selected center, so a character cannot disappear; extra occurrences can always be reduced until exactly one remains.
editorial: Operations never remove the selected center, so a character cannot disappear; extra occurrences can always be reduced until exactly one remains.

tests.explanation: Operations on a can delete two copies, leaving one each of a, b, and c for length three.
One operation centered on b deletes the other b, leaving three distinct characters.
